decisions.quote: Reproduction result: The focal test could not be reproduced – the dataset does not match the reproduction code provided, i.e. it does not contain the same number of observations reported in the paper, and it does not contain the variables called for in the reproduction code.
decisions.location: Reproduction result (line 12) and PBR troubleshooting details (line 16)
decisions.reason: The dataset lacks the variables required by the reproduction code and lacks documentation or instructions on how to prepare the data for analysis, so the focal test workflow could not be run and no comparable numerical output was produced. Under the codebook boundary, 'computational issues' requires that the analysis ran and produced numbers that disagreed with the original, whereas 'technical failure' applies when unusable or mismatched data/code/documentation prevents the analysis from running and producing comparable numbers.
